qs.q: Do you have many friends?
qs.a: I have a few close friends and many acquaintances. I met most of my close friends at university.
qs.tip: فرّق بين close friends وacquaintances لتظهر مفردات أدق.

qs.q: What do you usually do with your friends?
qs.a: We often study together, play football or just have tea and talk. It's a good way to relax after a busy week.
qs.tip: اذكر ثلاثة أنشطة بسيطة.

qs.q: What makes a good friend?
qs.a: A good friend is honest and loyal, and listens when you have a problem. Trust is the most important thing for me.
qs.tip: استعمل صفات مثل honest وloyal وreliable.

qs.q: Do you keep in touch with old friends?
qs.a: Yes, mostly by messages and sometimes by video calls. We try to meet up whenever I go back to my hometown.
qs.tip: keep in touch وmeet up عبارتان مفيدتان.

qs.q: Do you enjoy shopping?
qs.a: Not really. I find it tiring to walk around crowded shops, so I only go when I need something specific.
qs.tip: اشرح رأيك السلبي بلطف دون مبالغة.

qs.q: Do you prefer shopping online or in shops?
qs.a: I usually shop online because it saves time and prices are easy to compare. For clothes, though, I prefer trying things on in a shop.
qs.tip: though في نهاية الجملة طبيعية جدًا في الكلام.

qs.q: What was the last thing you bought?
qs.a: I bought a new pair of headphones last week. They have good sound, and they help me concentrate while I study.
qs.tip: الماضي البسيط مع الزمن last week.

qs.q: Do you usually spend a lot of money when you shop?
qs.a: No, I try to stick to a budget. I make a list before I go out so that I don't buy things I don't need.
qs.tip: stick to a budget وso that جملتان مفيدتان.

qs.q: How do you usually get to the university?
qs.a: I usually take the bus because it's cheap and direct. When the weather is nice, I sometimes walk.
qs.tip: اذكر الوسيلة والسبب ثم استثناءً.

qs.q: What is public transport like in your city?
qs.a: It's quite basic. Buses are fairly cheap, but they aren't always on time and they get crowded in the morning.
qs.tip: fairly وquite تخفف الحكم وتجعله واقعيًا.

qs.q: Do you prefer travelling by car or by train?
qs.a: I prefer the train because I can read or work during the journey. A car is more flexible, though, especially for short trips.
qs.tip: اربط تفضيلك بشيء تفعله أثناء الرحلة.

qs.q: How could transport in your area be improved?
qs.a: There should be more frequent buses and better bus stops. A tram or a train line would also reduce traffic.
qs.tip: should وwould تناسبان الاقتراحات.

qs.q: How many hours do you usually sleep?
qs.a: I usually sleep about seven hours. During exams, I sleep less, but I try to catch up at the weekend.
qs.tip: catch up عبارة تعني التعويض.

qs.q: Do you have any problems sleeping?
qs.a: Sometimes I find it hard to fall asleep if I've used my phone late. I'm trying to read a book instead.
qs.tip: fall asleep تُستعمل بدل sleep عند الحديث عن بدء النوم.

qs.q: Do you ever take naps during the day?
qs.a: Yes, a short nap after lunch helps me feel fresh again. I try not to sleep for more than twenty minutes.
qs.tip: take a nap تعبير شائع.

qs.q: Why do you think sleep is important?
qs.a: Without enough sleep, it's difficult to concentrate or remember things. It also affects your health and your mood.
qs.tip: اذكر أثرين: العقل والصحة.

qs.q: Are you a morning person?
qs.a: Not really. I'm more productive in the evening, but I'm trying to get up earlier so that I can study in the quiet hours.
qs.tip: morning person تعني شخصًا نشيطًا في الصباح.

qs.q: What do you usually do in the morning?
qs.a: I have a light breakfast, check my messages and then leave for the university. I never skip breakfast because it gives me energy.
qs.tip: استخدم never مع المضارع البسيط للعادات.

qs.q: What time do you normally get up?
qs.a: I get up at about six on weekdays, but at the weekend, I stay in bed until eight.
qs.tip: about لتقريب الأرقام.

qs.q: Do you think getting up early is a good habit?
qs.a: I do. You have more time to plan your day, and the morning is a good time to study when your mind is fresh.
qs.tip: I do جواب مختصر ثم سبب.

qs.q: What languages do you speak?
qs.a: I speak Arabic and French, and I'm learning English. I'd like to improve my English because I need it for my research.
qs.tip: اذكر لغاتك ثم الدافع للتعلم.

qs.q: Why are you learning English?
qs.a: I need it to read academic papers and to study abroad. English is also the language of most international research.
qs.tip: اذكر سببين: الدراسة والبحث.

qs.q: What do you find difficult about learning a language?
qs.a: Speaking is the hardest part for me. I know many words, but I'm sometimes nervous about making mistakes.
qs.tip: اعترف بصعوبة محددة وليس بشكل عام.

qs.q: How do you practise your English?
qs.a: I read articles, listen to podcasts and repeat sentences aloud. I also try to write short texts every day.
qs.tip: اذكر ثلاثة أنشطة بصيغة مضارع.

qs.q: How often do you use the internet?
qs.a: I use it every day, for several hours. Most of the time, it's for study, but I also watch videos and talk to friends.
qs.tip: for several hours وmost of the time تعبيرات للتكرار.

qs.q: What do you mostly use the internet for?
qs.a: Mostly for research and learning. I look up articles, watch online lectures and sometimes read the news.
qs.tip: look up عبارة فعلية تعني بحث عن معلومة.

qs.q: Do you think the internet has any disadvantages?
qs.a: Yes, there's a lot of false information and it can waste a lot of time. People also need to protect their personal data.
qs.tip: اذكر عيبين ثم لا تطل.

qs.q: How did people live before the internet?
qs.a: They used books, libraries and letters. Life was slower, but finding information took much more effort.
qs.tip: استعمل الماضي البسيط لوصف الماضي.

qs.q: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
qs.a: I live in an apartment on the third floor. It has three rooms and a small balcony.
qs.tip: صف البيت بعدد الغرف وميزة واحدة.

qs.q: What is your favourite room in your home?
qs.a: My favourite room is my study. It has a big desk and a window, and it's the quietest place in the house.
qs.tip: اذكر الغرفة ثم أسباب تحبها.

qs.q: Would you like to change anything about your home?
qs.a: I'd like a bigger desk and more shelves for my books. A garden would be wonderful, but it's not possible in an apartment.
qs.tip: الشرط الثاني تعبير جيد عن الأمنية.

qs.q: Do you want to stay there in the future?
qs.a: For now, yes, but I might move abroad for my studies. Then I'd probably rent a small flat near the university.
qs.tip: might وprobably تعبران عن عدم اليقين.

qs.q: What do you usually do at weekends?
qs.a: I usually relax and catch up with my family. On Fridays, we have a big lunch together, and in the evening I see my friends.
qs.tip: اذكر نشاطين ثم زمنًا محددًا.

qs.q: Do you prefer to be busy or relaxed at the weekend?
qs.a: A bit of both. I like to study for a couple of hours in the morning, and after that I want to relax.
qs.tip: A bit of both إجابة ذكية عندما يكون الخياران صحيحين.

qs.q: What did you do last weekend?
qs.a: I went to the market with my mother and then watched a football match with my brother. It was a simple but enjoyable weekend.
qs.tip: استعمل الماضي البسيط وكلمات الربط then.

qs.q: What would be your perfect weekend?
qs.a: A perfect weekend would be a short trip to the mountains with friends, followed by a good meal. No work and no alarm clock!
qs.tip: would be لوصف الحلم أو المثال الأعلى.

qs.q: Do you like spending time in nature?
qs.a: Yes, I do. Walking in the forest clears my mind and helps me forget about my work for a while.
qs.tip: clear your mind عبارة طبيعية.

qs.q: Are there any natural places near where you live?
qs.a: There's a beautiful forest of cedar trees about thirty minutes from my city. In spring, many families go there for picnics.
qs.tip: استعمل there is لتقديم مكان.

qs.q: Do you think people care enough about nature?
qs.a: Not enough, in my opinion. There's a lot of rubbish in public places, and people often waste water.
qs.tip: not enough تعبير مهذب عن النقد.

qs.q: What can ordinary people do to protect the environment?
qs.a: They can recycle, use less plastic and save water and electricity. Planting trees together is also a great idea.
qs.tip: can مع قائمة من الحلول العملية.

qs.q: What do you usually do on holidays?
qs.a: I usually visit my relatives and spend time at home. If I have a longer break, I go on a short trip with my friends.
qs.tip: If مع المضارع البسيط لحالة محتملة.

qs.q: What is your favourite holiday or festival?
qs.a: I love Eid because the whole family gets together. We share special food, and the children get gifts.
qs.tip: اذكر مناسبة عامة محايدة وسببًا اجتماعيًا.

qs.q: Do you prefer holidays by the sea or in the mountains?
qs.a: The sea, definitely. I love swimming and relaxing on the beach, although the mountains are cooler in summer.
qs.tip: definitely لتقوية الاختيار.

qs.q: Where did you go on your last holiday?
qs.a: I went to the coast with my family last summer. We rented a small flat near the beach and stayed for five days.
qs.tip: الماضي البسيط وتفاصيل صغيرة: كم يومًا وأين.

qs.q: What are you going to do after you finish your studies?
qs.a: I'm going to continue with a PhD abroad. After that, I'd like to work in research and teaching.
qs.tip: be going to للخطط المحددة.

qs.q: Where do you see yourself in ten years?
qs.a: I hope to be a researcher at a university, working on projects that help make public institutions fairer.
qs.tip: I hope to be + صفة أو مهنة صيغة مفيدة.

qs.q: Is there anything you want to achieve this year?
qs.a: I want to improve my English enough to take the IELTS exam. I also plan to publish my first research article.
qs.tip: want to وplan to بصيغتين مختلفتين.

qs.q: What could stop you from achieving your goals?
qs.a: Money could be a problem, and so could lack of time. But I'm determined to find scholarships and organise my time well.
qs.tip: could للاحتمال وdetermined لإظهار العزم.
